correctness.rationale: After independent unitary scaling of input/output near opposite endpoints, Γ(α+1)I^α becomes the selfadjoint Hankel kernel (1-(u+v)/α)_+^(α-1). For epsilon=1/alpha expand e^(-s)[1+epsilon(s-s²/2)] with uniform HS remainder O(epsilon²), using ∫∫F(u+v)² dudv=∫s F(s)²ds and exponential tail. With g=e^-u, h=(u-1/2)e^-u, a=(u/2-u²/2+1/8)e^-u, independently checked symbolic identity a(u)g(v)+g(u)a(v)-h(u)h(v)=e^(-(u+v))[(u+v)-(u+v)²/2]. Since <g,h>=0 and ||h||²=1/8, the rank-two model has one order-one positive and one -epsilon/8 negative eigenvalue: minmax and best-rank approximation imply s2=epsilon/8+O(epsilon²), higher squared singular tail O(epsilon^4). Exact total HS²=1/(4-2epsilon) gives s1=1/2+epsilon/8+epsilon²/32+O(epsilon³). Independent SymPy expansion reproduces 1/32. The asymptotics depend on analytic uniform HS bound, not Nyström numerics.
